speaker: Flo
text: Some experts claim that some “book sharing” is just a gimmick, the same stuff with a new label. From a business perspective, they think that today's “book sharing” is no different from the book-lending services some small bookstores have long offered. This is not real sharing as long as the book-sharing services require a deposit or impose a fine.
